asked.item: Commented GUIDE from own business account, no DM

verdict.reason: The pages say comments from the connected account are skipped and explain how to test from a different account.

steps.text: Your own comments do not trigger a DM automation, because Blotato skips comments posted by the same Instagram account connected to the automation.
To test, publish the automation, then sign in to a different Instagram or Facebook account.
From that account, leave a new top-level comment on the target post using one of the automation's keywords, because a reply to an existing comment does not trigger the automation.
Confirm the other account receives the direct message, and if no message arrives, open the automation and review its runs and logs.
